settings.title: North India
settings.intro: The cold mountains and royal plains of the north — where wool meets gold.
settings.cultures: Pashmina & Kani shawls — Kashmir | Kullu & Kinnauri shawls — Himachal | Phulkari embroidery — Punjab | Chikankari — Lucknow | Banarasi brocade — Varanasi
settings.usp: Luxe winter weaves and royal brocades. The north's story is fine wool, silk zari and the regal Banarasi loom.

settings.title: West & Central India
settings.intro: The print-and-dye powerhouse of the country — from the deserts of Kutch to the looms of Paithan.
settings.cultures: Bandhani tie-dye — Gujarat & Rajasthan | Patola double ikat — Patan | Ajrakh block print — Kutch | Bagru & Sanganeri prints — Rajasthan | Paithani silk — Maharashtra | Chanderi & Maheshwari — Madhya Pradesh | Kosa silk — Chhattisgarh
settings.usp: The masters of resist-dye and block print. Home to the legendary Patola — one of the world's most complex weaves.

settings.title: East India
settings.intro: Featherlight silks and narrative weaving, from the Ganges delta to the Northeast hills.
settings.cultures: Ikat of Odisha — single ikat | Sambalpuri & Bomkai — Odisha | Jamdani — Bengal | Kantha embroidery — Bengal | Bhagalpuri tussar — Bihar | Muga & Eri silk — Assam
settings.usp: Air-light muslins and golden Muga silk. The east weaves stories into every thread.

settings.title: South India
settings.intro: Temple-town silks and the double-ikat heartland, from Pochampally to Kanchipuram.
settings.cultures: Pochampally & Puttapaka ikat — Telangana | Kanjeevaram silk — Tamil Nadu | Uppada jamdani — Andhra | Kalamkari art — Andhra | Mysore silk & Ilkal — Karnataka | Kasavu — Kerala
settings.usp: The seat of the double ikat. South India dresses temples and weddings in silk and gold zari.

settings.quote: I didn't buy this because it was 'handloom'. I bought it because it's the best shirt in my closet.
Wore the co-ord to a wedding and to work the next week. That's rare with anything 'ethnic'.
Every piece comes with the story of who made it. That hits different once you know it.
